config.source:
SELECT i.*, r.review_outcome, r.review_note, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at FROM workspace.safestep.incidents i LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT review_rows.incident_id, review_rows.review_outcome, review_rows.review_note,
         review_rows.reviewed_by, review_rows.reviewed_at
  FROM (
    SELECT incident_id,
           outcome AS review_outcome,
           details AS review_note,
           actor AS reviewed_by,
           logged_at AS reviewed_at,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident_id ORDER BY logged_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events
    WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL
  ) review_rows
  WHERE review_rows.rn = 1
) r ON i.incident_id = r.incident_id

measures.name: possible_falls_alerted
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'fall' AND alert_sent = true)

measures.name: median_alert_to_ack_seconds
measures.expr: MEDIAN(CASE WHEN acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL AND alerted_at IS NOT NULL THEN (unix_timestamp(acknowledged_at) - unix_timestamp(alerted_at)) END)

measures.name: acknowledged_incidents
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) FILTER (WHERE acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL)

measures.name: unacknowledged_incidents
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) FILTER (WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL AND alerted_at IS NOT NULL)

measures.name: incidents_missing_room
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE room IS NULL OR room = '')

measures.name: incidents_missing_device
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE device_id IS NULL OR device_id = '')

measures.name: caregiver_confirmed_falls
measures.comment: Distinct incidents where the caregiver reported the outcome as a confirmed fall. Caregiver-reported observation, not a verified clinical finding.

measures.name: caregiver_no_fall_reports
measures.comment: Distinct incidents where the caregiver reported that no fall occurred.

measures.name: caregiver_unsure_reviews
measures.comment: Distinct incidents where the caregiver recorded 'unsure'. Distinct from unreviewed (no review recorded).

measures.name: awaiting_review_incidents
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('fall', 'near_fall') AND status IN ('cancelled', 'resolved') AND review_outcome IS NULL)
measures.comment: Fall or near-fall incidents with status cancelled or resolved that have no recorded caregiver review. A cancellation is not a review outcome and does not mean there was no fall.

config.comment: Incident-level SafeStep metrics, one row per incident derived from the lifecycle log. Fall events use event_type 'fall' and are detections, not confirmed injuries. Caregiver review fields (review_outcome, review_note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) come from lifecycle rows that carry a non-null outcome; a null review_outcome means no caregiver review has been recorded (unreviewed), which is distinct from 'unsure'. Review outcomes are caregiver-reported observations, not verified clinical findings.

dimensions.name: confidence_normalized
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN confidence > 1 THEN confidence / 100.0 ELSE confidence END

dimensions.name: confidence_band
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN confidence IS NULL THEN 'Not recorded' WHEN `confidence_normalized` < 0.50 THEN 'Low (below 0.50)' WHEN `confidence_normalized` < 0.70 THEN 'Medium (0.50 to 0.69)' WHEN `confidence_normalized` < 0.85 THEN 'High (0.70 to 0.84)' ELSE 'Very high (0.85 and above)' END

dimensions.name: review_outcome
dimensions.comment: Caregiver-reported review outcome ('confirmed_fall', 'no_fall', 'unsure'); NULL means no caregiver review recorded yet. Caregiver-reported observation, not a verified clinical finding.

dimensions.name: review_status
dimensions.comment: Review outcome with NULL shown as 'unreviewed'; 'unreviewed' is distinct from 'unsure'.

config.source:
SELECT 'incidents' AS source_name, 'confidence' AS field_name, COUNT(1) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE confidence IS NULL) AS missing_rows
FROM workspace.safestep.incidents UNION ALL SELECT 'incidents', 'room', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE room IS NULL OR room = '') FROM workspace.safestep.incidents UNION ALL SELECT 'incidents', 'device_id', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE device_id IS NULL OR device_id = '') FROM workspace.safestep.incidents UNION ALL SELECT 'incidents', 'timestamp', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE `timestamp` IS NULL) FROM workspace.safestep.incidents UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_events', 'confidence', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE confidence IS NULL) FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_events', 'room', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE room IS NULL OR room = '') FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_events', 'device_id', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE device_id IS NULL OR device_id = '') FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_events', 'detected_at', COUNT(1), COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE detected_at IS NULL) FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events
config.comment: Field-level completeness profile of the SafeStep incident and lifecycle sources

config.source:
SELECT *,
       MIN(CASE WHEN lifecycle IN ('alerted', 'delivered') THEN logged_at END)
         OVER (PARTITION BY incident_id) AS incident_alert_at
FROM workspace.safestep.lifecycle_events

measures.name: camera_offline_episodes
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'camera_offline' OR lifecycle = 'camera_offline')

measures.name: events_missing_room
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE room IS NULL OR room = '')

measures.name: events_missing_device
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE device_id IS NULL OR device_id = '')

config.comment: Row-level SafeStep lifecycle events including alert delivery, escalation, and device or camera events

dimensions.name: delivery_stage
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN lifecycle = 'alerted' THEN 'Alert attempted by service' WHEN lifecycle = 'delivered' THEN 'Accepted by ntfy' WHEN lifecycle = 'delivery_failed' THEN 'Delivery failed' ELSE lifecycle END

lines: How to read this dashboard: **possible falls are detections, not confirmed injuries**. A cancelled alert is a cancellation, not proof of a false alarm. Confidence is a detection score, not a probability of injury. Nothing here shows that the system prevented a fall. Empty tiles mean no matching events in the current filters and date range.

All charts on this page show **detected possible falls** — events the SafeStep system flagged as possible falls. They are **not confirmed injuries**, and nothing here confirms that an injury occurred. Detection confidence is the model's score for the detection itself; it is **not a probability of injury** and not a medical risk measure. A cancelled alert means the alert was cancelled — it is **not proof that the detection was a false alarm**.

Time-based charts on this page use **alert time** (when the alert was sent), not detection time. Possible falls that never produced an alert are excluded from those alert-time charts rather than silently shown at another time.

lines:
**Prevention signals are not fall incidents.** This page shows near-falls and other hazard events — obstacles, low light, night wandering, and inactivity where present in the data — separately from detected possible falls, so they are never counted toward fall totals. These are detected warning signs about the environment or behaviour. Nothing on this dashboard shows that any fall was prevented.

Time charts on this page use **alert time** where the event produced an alert; events with no alert keep their **detection time** so they stay visible rather than disappearing from the charts.

lines: How to read this page: review outcomes are **caregiver-reported observations**, not verified clinical findings. **Unreviewed** means no caregiver review has been recorded yet — it is distinct from **unsure**, which is an explicit caregiver answer. A **cancelled alert is a cancellation only**, kept separate from review outcomes; a cancellation alone does not mean there was no fall. Counters count distinct incidents. Date and event-type filters in the global filter bar also apply to this page; empty tiles mean no matching events in the current filters and date range.
